snippet.title: Cheese Dreams (2025). Game by Jacob Buczynski, aka Jinxtengu.
snippet.description:
Description below, unfold.
Description from the author of the game: This game is probably the greatest game ever made.
A very long and experiMENTAL game. Over 600 screens.
Highly non-linear
If you like this, please post youtube and tik-tok videos so that my games become better known.
Released 9th of July 2025
Download link for Cheese Dreams game and other games on Jinxtengu website: http://www.revengeofthesunfish.com/gamesarc.html
The link to the site itself is from Jinxtengu: http://www.revengeofthesunfish.com/index.html
Link to the Jinxtengu channel: https://www.youtube.com/user/Revengeofthesunfish
Link to the Jinxtengu Twitter page: https://twitter.com/jinxtengu
